radiation._about: Solar particle event rules. The storm rate itself is REAL (src/data/real/radlab_sep.json). shelterAboveUGyPerHour and unshelteredDamagePerHour are GAME RULES (not a medical model); NASA-STD-3001 only says to alert the crew and shelter them (250 mSv per-event limit).

shelter._about: Storm shelter = the sleep capsule in Personal: only a head inside the capsule counts as sheltered (crew:shelter). Its shell is a water wall wallM thick (1 cm of water ≈ 1 g/cm²; NASA OCHMO-TB-020 asks ~10 g/cm² on a planetary surface). Water-wall shelters are a real design idea (ISS crew quarters, Orion). Sizes in metres; cornerM is the radius of the capsule's top corners.
